summary: Revised implementation plan for VU LMS Activity Reminder App incorporating user feedback: strict suppression of past-date notifications, customizable notification and full-screen alarm types for urgent same-day deadlines, activity completion tracking with persistent hash IDs to prevent duplicate alerts, first-launch privacy & disclaimer modal with zero-data-leak guarantee, and a dedicated founder credit block for Hanzla Rehman (GitHub: hanzlarehman404) with avatar.
